about: M6-F8 tiered tests (docs/program/requirements/M6-reliability-cost.md). Which tiers a change needs. T1 runs on every PR; T2 and T3 are needed when a changed file starts with one of their paths. CI reads this file (.github/ci/tiers.mjs) and writes the tiers a PR needs to the run summary; the PR template asks which ones ran.

T0.what: lint, typecheck and the unit tests related to the changed files, on the builder's machine

T1.what: CI: lint and typecheck, the unit tests in 6 shards balanced by file time, the real-Postgres tests, the infra and matting tests, the intake browser scenarios

T2.what: the real-photo regression set (about 30 real sources with stored mattes)
T2.when: PRs touching render, matte, shadow, crop or QA
T2.notBuiltBecause: M6-S7a decision S7a-4: the set needs real brand photos and their mattes, which cannot live in the public repository, and CI has no GCP access to read them from a bucket. Until it is built, a PR that needs T2 runs the render, matte and image-check unit tests in T1 and says so in the PR.

T3.what: a 20-product golden batch on the preview stack with the built images (spec 10 checkers)
T3.when: PRs touching the pipeline, before deploy
T3.notBuiltBecause: M6-S7a decision S7a-4: it deploys to preview, which waits for the owner's typed approval per deploy; it is run by hand with infra/deploy-preview.sh until a later slice automates it.

T4.what: deploy gates and the per-brand smoke
T4.when: every deploy, only for changed services

T5.what: full evals, the 300-product golden set, load tests
T5.when: nightly or before a release, on separate capacity
T5.run: the catalog-eval, catalog-output-evals and catalog-load jobs
